column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_story.prx (runtime base 0x08e9aa00, shared slot: registry ids carry the
# rel_story: prefix, addresses here do not); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Recomputes the calendar block from its slot counter t (+0x00): slot +0x04 = (t-1)%7+1, day +0x10 = (t-1)/7, day number +0x0c = day+1, light period +0x14 from the table rel_story +0x208ec, weekday +0x1c = (day%7+1)%7. Never writes +0x08, +0x18, +0x20. Callers: world_advance_time_slot, world_advance_time_slots, world_set_time_slot, world_advance_to_next_day.
Calendar t += 1, then world_update_calendar. Caller: world_change_time (mode 2).
Calendar t += 7 - (t-1)%7 (slot 1 of the next day), then world_update_calendar. Caller: world_change_time (modes 5 and 6).
Returns the calendar weekday +0x1c (0 Sunday, 1 Monday). No side effects. Callers: world_change_time, 0x08eab474, 0x08ea2ef0.
Compares the calendar day index +0x10 with the last seen day at field save block +0x04; when they differ stores the new day there and returns 1, else returns 0. Caller: world_change_time.

Mode 2 +1 slot, 3 +n slots, 4 slot n of the day, 5 next day, 6 location 14 and next day, 7 slot 4; other modes only refresh. On a new day (world_check_new_day): system flag 1 cleared, world_pick_sandwich_seller, world_assign_daily_spots on Mondays (world_get_weekday == 1), daily randoms, story flags 1-20 cleared. Always ends with world_update_npc_positions. Callers: 13 sites (story init 0x08e9f3ac, island map, exits, the event driver, PDA time menu).

Sets system flag 4 to 1 when partner is 27, to 0 when partner is 26, otherwise at random (rand & 1); the flag picks which seller (26/27) sells sandwiches. Callers: world_change_time (each new day), 0x08e9b5d8.

Weekly NPC pairing: groups the 140 runtime characters (fixed ones excluded) by category, shuffles, mixes category 2 with 0/1, writes those with record flags 1 and 5 clear to the field save block +0x1c (140 bytes, 0xff = end) and clears their flag 2; with an odd count character 100 gets flag 2 and is dropped; each pair gets random flags 6-8 and two neighbouring free spots (s-1, s) of the spot table (record +0x18); then per-character randoms and one save bit. Caller: world_change_time.

For each of the 140 runtime records (0x5c bytes): character 51 flag 1 from slot 3 on; flag 3 (absent) in slots 3-4 unless flag 6; location +0x00, cell +0x0c/+0x10 and direction +0x15 from world_get_fixed_npc_spot or the spot +0x18; +0x58 = current day index; byte +0x16 = 6 when flag 8; then 0x08e9e340. The flag world_change_time passes in a0 is not read. Caller: world_change_time.

Adds delta to the character's friendship points (save_get/set/add_char_points), clamped to 0 and to world_get_points_cap() (0xffff on overflow); calls 0x08eaa6bc(delta) when the value changes. Returns 1 (raised), -1 (lowered) or 0 (already at the cap). Caller: world_change_partner_points_shown (story opcodes 50084/50085).

Gift of the current item to the partner: taste = character table[partner][world_item_taste_column(item)], random 1-5 for taste 6 or item 48, clamped to 1-5; queues the partner's reaction (character table column variant+1, 6, taste) and (301, 6, taste), or (301, 6, 6) for item 50; also calls 0x08ea5884(item). The points change comes from the queued records. Caller: world_driver_handle_result.
Opcode 50105: world_change_time(4, a1), jump to slot a1 of the day. Side effects: calendar, NPC positions (see world_change_time). Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Opcode 50118: field request 26 with dialogue_map_hud_marker(a1) (1 -> -1 off, 3-7 -> 1-5), waiting until the field module polls done. Side effects: field HUD marker. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50137: VM word +0xc = 1; world_driver_finish_partner_story acts on it after the script returns. Side effects: VM state. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50148: field state byte +0x65 += 1; at 5 or more sets system flag 24 (consumed by world_driver_next_event). Side effects: field state, system flags. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50149: sets system flag 25 (consumed by world_driver_next_event). Side effects: system flags. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Opcode 50156 and before a track change: when a track is current, fade (0x0884192c(1500)), stop (0x088418f8) and release (0x08841850) it, waiting with system_wait_frame between the steps; current track = -1. Side effects: sound state, blocks for several frames. Callers: 0x08ea2cdc, 0x08eaa76c (the track change of the bgm opcode).
Opcode 50162 (set-up pass): world_set_event_deck(a1, a2), the deck-recipe index the character uses during the event. Side effects: runtime record +0x42. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50170 (set-up pass): world_set_event_remark(a1, a2), the remark index the field shows for the character during the event. Side effects: runtime record +0x3f. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Sets (on != 0) or clears bit flag-1 of one of four u32 flag words: 1-32 field save block +0x14, 33-64 +0x18, 65-96 and 97-128 in the block at *(0x08ecea6c) +0x8/+0xc; other values are ignored. Side effects: story flags. 28 callers, including world_change_time, world_op_buy_sandwich, dialogue_op_series_win.
Switch: story location 1-5 -> map 1-5, 6-21 -> 12-27, 22-25 -> 29-32, 26 -> 36, 27-30 -> 39-42, 0 and others -> 30. No side effects. Callers: world_send_exit_cells, world_open_island_map.
Inverse switch; maps 37 and 38 (second versions) -> locations 6 and 13; unlisted ids -> 0. No side effects. Callers: world_poll_island_map, world_handle_field_action (door cells).

Returns the exit-group key of the first selector record (rel_story +0x1f968, 9 u16) of the location whose story-stage, story-flag and record-flag conditions pass (mode 3 fails while the flag is clear, 4 while it is set). On the disc every record is unconditional; locations 27-29 use groups 37-39 although they load maps 39-41. Caller: world_get_exit_cells.

column2: void world_get_exit_cells(int location, short * cells, int * count)
column3: Appends the cells of the selected group (rel_story +0x1fb84, {u16 key, x, y} records) to cells as {s16 x, s16 y}, at most 128, incrementing *count. Caller: world_send_exit_cells.

Clears the 0x200-byte cell buffer 0x08ecd998 and its count 0x08ecdb98, fills them with world_get_exit_cells when world_get_driver_event_flag() is 0 or the location is 7-15 or 28 (otherwise an empty list), then sends field request 3 {world_location_to_map_id(location), buffer, count} and waits for it. Caller: 0x08ea1d90 (state 4, map entry).

When an event places the player (0x08e9b400 or world_get_driver_event_flag), keeps the field-state position; otherwise picks a fixed cell and direction per location (some by previous location, system flags 20 and 6 (6 is then cleared), or the previous cell for locations 6 and 28; table in docs/formats/field-maps.md), centres it (x * 0.5 + 0.25), stores it with world_set_player_position and sends field request 9. Caller: 0x08ea1d90 (state 4).

column2: int world_get_fixed_npc_spot(int chr, int partner, int * location, int * x, int * y, int * direction)
column3: Characters 51, 127-136, 138, 140: the 16-byte entry of rel_story +0x2238c; 139: the entry of +0x21f0c selected by field save block byte +2; sellers 26/27: entry 0 or 1 of +0x2e550 by system flag 4 (entry 0 when the partner is a seller); 140 takes entry 2 when the partner is a seller. Returns 1 and writes the four outputs; 0 for other characters. Caller: world_update_npc_positions.
Clears the word 0x08ec909c. Side effects: writes 0x08ec909c. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the word 0x08ec909c. Side effects: writes 0x08ec909c. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).
Clears the 0x84-byte map pick-up block 0x08ec90a0. Side effects: writes 0x08ec90a0-0x08ec9123. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the 0x84-byte map pick-up block 0x08ec90a0. Side effects: writes 0x08ec90a0-0x08ec9123. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).
Stores the pointer to the map pick-up taken bits in 0x08ec9124. Side effects: writes 0x08ec9124. Callers: 1 (world_story_init).
Stores the map pick-up table pointer in the first word of the 0x84-byte block 0x08ec90a0. Side effects: writes 0x08ec90a0. Callers: 1 (dialogue_bind_script_tables).
Clears the 8 bytes at 0x08ec9128 (the force-location-setup flag and the fade state word 0x08ec912c). Side effects: writes 0x08ec9128-0x08ec912f. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the 8 bytes at 0x08ec9128 (the force-location-setup flag and the fade state word 0x08ec912c). Side effects: writes 0x08ec9128-0x08ec912f. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).
Stores the scene context pointer (story block +0x3250, 0x14 bytes) in 0x08ec9130. Side effects: writes 0x08ec9130. Callers: 1 (world_story_init).
Clears the 0x14-byte scene context *(0x08ec9130). Side effects: writes the scene context. Callers: 1 (world_story_init).

Stores value in word +0x00 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130); its guard (value >= 0 or value < 0x26) is always true. Side effects: writes that word. Callers: 2 (world_handle_field_action, world_state_update_tutorial_list).
Returns word +0x00 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130) (story block +0x3250). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_state_start_deck_tutorial, world_state_start_tutorial_list).

Stores on in 0x08ec9128, the flag read by world_is_force_location_setup. Side effects: writes 0x08ec9128. Callers: 4 (world_state_enter_location, world_state_shutdown_field_module, world_state_open_island_map, world_story_init).

Returns whether the word 0x08ec9128 (set by world_set_force_location_setup) is non-zero. No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_state_enter_location, world_place_player_on_arrival, audio_select_scene_bgm, world_send_npc_list).

Stores mode in word +0x04 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). Side effects: writes that word. Callers: 10 (world_state_shutdown_shop, world_handle_item_menu_action, world_handle_field_action, world_story_init, ...).
Returns word +0x04 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_story_init, world_leave_field_scene, audio_select_scene_bgm, world_exit_story_scene).
Stores value in the u16 +0x0c of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). Side effects: writes that u16. Callers: 2 (world_driver_finish_partner_story, world_story_init).
Returns the u16 +0x0c of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_exit_story_scene).
Stores value in word +0x08 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). Side effects: writes that word. Callers: 2 (world_post_field_request_31, world_change_time).
Returns word +0x08 of the scene context *(0x08ec9130). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_post_field_request_31, world_place_player_on_arrival).

Stores state in the word 0x08ec912c. Side effects: writes 0x08ec912c. Callers: 12 (world_state_shutdown_shop, world_state_update_duel_record, world_state_update_conv_machine, world_state_update_deck_tutorial, ...).

Changes character's friendship points with world_change_char_points and shows the result: sends field request 28 with 2 for an increase (+1), 1 for a decrease (-1) and 0 for no change, then waits frames until thunk_world_field_poll(0x1c) reports it done. Side effects: those of world_change_char_points (save points) and of field request 28 (partner mood animation). Callers: 2 (dialogue_op_partner_points_sub, dialogue_op_partner_points_add).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_state_open_island_map).

Searches the character table rows (world_get_char_table_cell(row, 0) == character, 140 rows) and returns column 6 of the row (1 = excluded from the daily pairing), or 0 when not found. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reroll_npc_remarks).

Gets the next chapter event of the partner chapter table (world_get_next_chapter_event, which skips empty entries), queues its key {a1, a2, a3} with world_queue_event and advances the chapter step with world_advance_chapter_step. Side effects: event queue entry, chapter step byte. Callers: 1 (world_story_init).

Looks up the chapter-table entry of the current story stage and chapter step with world_lookup_chapter_event(stage, step, the four outputs); while the lookup returns 0 (empty entry) advances the chapter step and retries. Side effects: the outputs; the chapter step byte for skipped entries (world_advance_chapter_step). Callers: 4 (world_queue_next_chapter_event, world_open_island_map, world_driver_next_event, world_try_chapter_event).
Returns 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_open_island_map).
Clears the 0x4830-byte block 0x08ec9134. Side effects: writes 0x08ec9134-0x08ecd963. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the 0x4830-byte block 0x08ec9134. Side effects: writes 0x08ec9134-0x08ecd963. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).

Bisection search of the runtime character records (base *(0x08ecd964), 0x5c bytes each, sorted by the character id at +0x1c) for character. Returns the record address, 0 when not found, or the base address after 0x10000 iterations. No side effects. Callers: 40 (world_get_record_event_pos_x, world_set_record_event_facing, world_set_record_duel_key, world_get_record_cell_x, ...).

Returns the name string of character in its current variant: thunk_world_call_get_character_name_string(0, character, world_get_variant(character)) (word 0 of the row's names in chr_name_<lang>.bin). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_send_npc_list, dialogue_show_narration, dialogue_op_npc_appear_leave, dialogue_show_talk_line).

column2: void world_set_record_flag(int character, int bit, int on)
column3: Finds the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record) and sets (on != 0) or clears bit bit - 1 of its flag word +0x54. Side effects: writes record +0x54. Callers: 7 (world_assign_daily_spots, world_story_init, world_init_character_records, world_update_npc_positions, ...).

Finds the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record) and returns whether bit bit - 1 of its flag word +0x54 is set (record flags 1-8, world.md). No side effects. Callers: 6 (world_select_exit_group, world_send_npc_list, world_assign_daily_spots, world_update_npc_positions, ...).
Stores spot in the u16 +0x18 (spot index of the spot table) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x18. Callers: 1 (world_assign_daily_spots).

Returns the u16 +0x00 (current location) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 2 (dialogue_op_if_npc_location, world_get_npc_location).
Returns the u16 +0x28 (event set-up location) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_location).

Returns the friendship points of character: passes the argument through to thunk_save_get_char_points (u16 at +0x16 of the save character record). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_update_npc_deck_indices, world_open_island_map, world_select_partner_event, dialogue_op_if_char_points).
Stores variant in word +0x20 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x20. Callers: 1 (world_init_character_records).

column2: void world_set_record_event_position(int character, int x, int y)
column3: Stores x and y in words +0x2c and +0x30 (event set-up position) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x2c and +0x30. Callers: 2 (dialogue_op_npc_position, world_handle_field_action).

Stores facing in byte +0x3c (event set-up facing) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x3c. Callers: 2 (dialogue_op_npc_direction, world_handle_field_action).
Returns word +0x04 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_pos_x).
Returns word +0x0c (cell x) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_cell_x).
Returns word +0x2c (event set-up position) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_pos_x).
Returns word +0x34 (event set-up cell x) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_cell_x).
Returns word +0x08 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_pos_y).
Returns word +0x10 (cell y) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_cell_y).
Returns word +0x30 (event set-up position) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_pos_y).
Returns word +0x38 (event set-up cell y) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_cell_y).
Returns byte +0x14 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_facing).
Returns byte +0x15 (direction) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_direction).
Returns byte +0x3c (event set-up facing) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_facing).
Returns byte +0x3d (event set-up direction) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_direction).
Returns byte +0x16 of the runtime record of character (set to 6 with record flag 8 by world_update_npc_positions; world.md). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_byte16).
Returns byte +0x17 (remark index) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_remark).
Returns byte +0x3e (event set-up counterpart of +0x16) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_byte16).
Returns byte +0x3f (event set-up remark) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_get_npc_remark).

Finds the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record, argument passed through) and stores variant in its u16 +0x40, the event variant (65000 = none). Side effects: writes record +0x40. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_npc_set_variant).
Stores deck in the u16 +0x42 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x42. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_npc_deck).
Stores value in the u16 +0x44 of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x44. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_npc_value_44).
Stores remark in byte +0x3f (event set-up remark) of the runtime record of character (world_find_runtime_record). Side effects: writes record +0x3f. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_npc_remark).

Returns the address +4 of the character's entry in the 0x84-byte character info table 0x08ec9134, found with world_find_char_info_entry (argument passed through; the result is 4 when that returns 0). No side effects. Callers: 2 (dialogue_op_npc_appear_leave, world_send_npc_list).
Returns the character id (word +0x1c) of runtime record index (base *(0x08ecd964), 0x5c bytes each). No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_send_npc_list, world_assign_daily_spots, world_story_init).
Returns the variant (word +0x20) of runtime record index (base *(0x08ecd964), 0x5c bytes each). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_assign_daily_spots).
Clears the 2 bytes at 0x08ecd96c. Side effects: writes 0x08ecd96c-0x08ecd96d. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the 2 bytes at 0x08ecd96c. Side effects: writes 0x08ecd96c-0x08ecd96d. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).
Returns expression for 0..16 and 0 for anything else (identity table). No side effects. Callers: 3 (dialogue_op_portrait, dialogue_op_talk, dialogue_op_talk_pair).

Maps a script direction to the field direction: 8 -> 1, 9 -> 3, 10 -> 5, 11 -> 7, anything else -> 0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (dialogue_op_scene_player, dialogue_op_npc_direction, world_set_record_event_direction).
Maps a script sound id to a sound number: 1 -> 0x7a5a, 2 -> 0x7adf, 3 -> 0x7ae0, 4 -> 0x7ae1, 5 -> 0x7ae2, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_sound_effect).

Maps a script BGM id 0..26 to a sound track: 0 -> 0, 1..8 -> 10..0x11, 9 -> 0x13, 10..0x17 -> 0x15..0x22, 0x18 -> 0x14, 0x19 -> 0x2e, 0x1a -> 0x2f; anything else -> 0. No side effects. Callers: 4 (dialogue_op_scene_bgm, dialogue_op_prefetch_bgm, dialogue_op_bgm, audio_select_scene_bgm).
Maps the hud_marker argument: 1 -> -1, 0 and 2 -> 0, 3..7 -> 1..5, anything else -> 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (dialogue_op_hud_marker).

Clears the 0x22c-byte story state variables at 0x08ecd970 (scene-done word 0x08ecd970, story state 0x08ecd978, step function 0x08ecd98c, ...). Side effects: writes 0x08ecd970-0x08ecdb9b. Callers: 1 (world_init_story_globals).
Clears the 0x22c-byte story state variables at 0x08ecd970. Side effects: writes 0x08ecd970-0x08ecdb9b. Callers: 1 (world_term_story_globals).
Copies the u16 *src to *dst and returns dst. Side effects: writes *dst. Callers: 1 (world_story_init).

When fade is non-zero, fades the screen out (world_fade_screen(0, 1, 0, 0)) and shows the loading overlay; fades the BGM out (audio_fade_out_bgm) unless the next scene mode is 3; switches off the 12 field overlays (world_switch_field_overlay(i, 0)); sets 0x08ecd970 = 1. Side effects: those of the callees; writes 0x08ecd970. Callers: 1 (world_story_state_step).
Returns the word 0x08ecd970 (set to 1 by world_leave_field_scene). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_story_scene_main).

Sends field request 1 with the driver event flag (world_get_driver_event_flag) through thunk_world_field_request and waits with thunk_system_wait_frame until thunk_world_field_poll(1) reports it done. Side effects: those of field request 1 (event mode, command bar). Callers: 1 (world_state_enter_location).

Returns whether thunk_world_field_poll(0x1f, buffer on the stack) reports field request 31 (start of the field) finished. Side effects: that of the poll (clears the request's active word when done). Callers: 2 (world_state_enter_location, world_state_open_island_map).

Starts field request 32 (end of the field) with thunk_world_field_request(0x20, buffer on the stack). Side effects: those of field request 32 (DP display and message window re-initialised, field components reset). Callers: 1 (world_wait_field_sync).

Returns whether thunk_world_field_poll(0x20, buffer on the stack) reports field request 32 (end of the field) finished. Side effects: that of the poll (clears the request's active word when done). Callers: 1 (world_wait_field_sync).

Story state: waits for the field (world_wait_field_sync), sets story state 0x08ecd978 = 4 (enter location) and shows the loading overlay (thunk_system_set_loading_overlay(1)). Side effects: writes 0x08ecd978; those of the callees. Callers: 1 (world_story_state_step).

Story state: releases the preloaded portraits (world_release_preloaded_portraits), starts field request 16 (free walk) with thunk_world_field_request(0x10, buffer on the stack) and sets story state 0x08ecd978 = 6. Side effects: those of the callees; writes 0x08ecd978. Callers: 1 (world_story_state_step).

Story state 7: waits for the field (world_wait_field_sync), advances the time by one slot (world_change_time(2, 0)) and sets story state 0x08ecd978 = 1 (island map). Side effects: those of world_change_time (calendar, daily updates); writes 0x08ecd978. Callers: 1 (world_story_state_step).

Story state for going to sleep: dialogue_close_all_windows, world_fade_screen(0, 1, 0, 0), thunk_system_set_loading_overlay(1), world_wait_field_sync, world_change_time(6, 0) (location 14 and next day), world_set_talk_target(-1), then story state 0x08ecd978 = 4. Side effects: those of the callees; writes 0x08ecd978. Callers: 1 (world_driver_handle_result).

Story sub-module state that starts the field module: thunk_world_field_init_module, one thunk_system_wait_frame, then thunk_system_set_loading_overlay(1). Side effects: those of the field module init and the loading overlay. No direct caller (story state function pointer; dialogue.md, sub-module states).

Story sub-module state that runs one field frame: thunk_world_field_update, then thunk_world_field_draw (rel_field). Side effects: those of the field update and draw. No direct caller (story state function pointer; dialogue.md, sub-module states).
